info.name: Dental Chart Management API
info.description:
API requirements for Dental Chart feature in Mobile Clinic Management System

## Overview
This collection defines the required APIs for managing dental charts, including:
- Tooth-level condition tracking (cavities, crowns, bridges, etc.)
- Procedure management with timeline tracking
- Treatment planning and progress monitoring
- Comprehensive reporting and data visualization

## Data Model

### Tooth Data Structure
```json
{
  "tooth_number": 11,
  "status": "in-treatment",
  "conditions": [...],
  "procedures": [...]
}
```

### Tooth Condition
```json
{
  "id": "unique-id",
  "type": "cavity|crown|bridge|implant|root-canal|extraction|filling|fracture|abscess|other",
  "severity": "mild|moderate|severe",
  "notes": "Description",
  "date": "2024-11-20",
  "created_at": "ISO 8601 timestamp",
  "updated_at": "ISO 8601 timestamp",
  "created_by": "practitioner_id"
}
```

### Tooth Procedure
```json
{
  "id": "unique-id",
  "name": "Root Canal Treatment",
  "status": "planned|in-progress|completed|cancelled",
  "notes": "Procedure notes",
  "date": "2024-11-20",
  "cost": 3000,
  "duration_minutes": 60,
  "created_at": "ISO 8601 timestamp",
  "updated_at": "ISO 8601 timestamp",
  "created_by": "practitioner_id",
  "timeline": [
    {
      "status": "planned",
      "timestamp": "ISO 8601 timestamp",
      "notes": "Optional notes",
      "changed_by": "practitioner_id"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Authentication
All endpoints require practitioner authentication via session cookies.

## Base URL
`{{base_url}}/api/method/mob_clinic.mob_clinic.api.dental_chart`

request.description:
Saves complete dental chart data for a patient. This endpoint handles:
- Creating new tooth records
- Updating existing conditions and procedures
- Maintaining timeline history for procedures
- Automatically calculating tooth status based on conditions/procedures

**Important Notes:**
1. IDs for conditions/procedures should be included when updating existing items
2. Omitting an ID creates a new record
3. Timeline entries are automatically created for procedure status changes
4. `created_by` and timestamps are set server-side

**Response Format:**
```json
{
  "message": "Dental chart saved successfully",
  "data": {
    "patient_id": "PAT-00001",
    "updated_teeth": [11, 16, 21],
    "new_conditions": 2,
    "new_procedures": 1,
    "updated_procedures": 3
  }
}
```

request.description:
Updates procedure status and automatically adds timeline entry if status changed.

**Important:** This endpoint should:
1. Check if status changed from previous value
2. If changed, create new timeline entry with timestamp
3. Update procedure's `updated_at` timestamp
4. Recalculate tooth status based on all procedures

**Response Format:**
```json
{
  "message": "Procedure status updated successfully",
  "data": {
    "procedure_id": "PROC-001",
    "tooth_number": 11,
    "old_status": "planned",
    "new_status": "in-progress",
    "timeline_entry_added": true,
    "updated_at": "2024-11-20T10:30:00Z"
  }
}
```

item.name: Reporting & Analytics

request.description:
Exports dental chart in specified format for printing or sharing.

**Response Format (for PDF/Excel):**
- Returns file download with appropriate Content-Type header
- Filename: `dental_chart_PAT00001_20241120.pdf`

**Response Format (for JSON):**
```json
{
  "message": "Chart exported successfully",
  "data": {
    "export_format": "json",
    "export_url": "/files/exports/dental_chart_PAT00001_20241120.json",
    "expires_at": "2024-11-21T10:30:00Z"
  }
}
```
